title: Dronagiri: Hanuman's mountain at real scale
caption:
This mountain is taller than 8 Burj Khalifas. And legend says Hanuman flew it to Lanka 🏔️

📖 Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda: Lakshmana falls in battle, Hanuman can't tell the herbs apart, so he lifts the whole peak.
📍 Tradition names it Dronagiri, Chamoli district, Uttarakhand: 7,066 m.
⚖️ Just its top 1 km ≈ 2.8 billion tonnes (our estimate: 1 km cone of rock), over 5× the weight of every human on Earth.
✈️ About 2,300 km to Lanka before sunrise = 230 km/h.
🏘️ In Dronagiri village, many still don't worship Hanuman.

Follow for more legends, at real scale.
